review_scope: All13 requests; top3/top5 representative six arms: English fields2cap64, nativephrase fields2cap64, stockEnglishphrase fields2cap64/anti64/RRF60full/lexical75d425full. Does not claim every75-arm tail independently adjudicated.

overall.assessment: Bounded preparation offers viable local overhead on some arms and genuine case gains, especially phrase-pool anti for wealth conjunction and fields2 for object centrality. No single reviewed arm clears material-regression gate. Full-list retention is diagnostic, not quality ground truth; unfamiliar direct fits are accepted. Whole-fit longtense and indirect relation gaps remain.
overall.timing_caveat: Use measured fresh normalization+selection+ranking total, not rank-only; combine with contemporaneous native source retrieval as reconstruction, not measured live end-to-end.

cases.assessment: fields2 cap64 car lists directly support chases; native phrase retains FastFive/LostBullet2/WhiteStorm. Gains mostly recover corrected quality.
fields2 cap64 across English/nativephrase/stockphrase consistently keeps plot-central TheyLive/Fiancés/Dream2; direct source-supported improvement over incidental third-place glasses tags.

English fields2 cap64 Ultrasound/MarbleHornets/ChasingSleep all explicitly unreliable narrators. Losing familiar FightClub/UsualSuspects is not intrinsically worse. Nativephrase still puts unreleased pilot#3 until separate cleanup.

Stockphrase anti64 Saltburn/Gemstones/WhiteLotus provides distributed wealthy-subject and darkcomedy support, stronger than genericdark prose arms. Stockphrase RRF Saltburn/Gemstones/Succession also promising. English fields2 cap64 retains generic satire; mechanism depends on source pool.
Gated empty for all shortlist arms; no production-fill claim.
Phrase anti64 Suburræterna/Gomorrah/Spiral all directly grittycrime. Fields2 varied police/crime leaders are supported; corrected already strong.

cases.request: I want something tense that keeps me guessing, but I don’t want to finish it feeling miserable.
cases.assessment: English fields2 cap64 Duranga/Terapist/ControlFactor emphasizes dark psychological suspense without nonmiserable support; stockphrase anti FoolMeOnce/Chosen/Caught retains ending unknowns. Earlier fullpool NowYouSeeMe benefit can disappear through shortlist truncation.

cases.request: Rich people being absolutely awful to each other, preferably funny.
cases.assessment: Stockphrase anti64 restores OurCartoonPresident/Saltburn/Gemstones, much stronger subject relation than fields2 Snake/Cartouche. RRF NeoYokio/Politician shifts to class/politics satire; preference rather than universal gain. Fields2 remains poor relation handling.

cases.request: A crime show that feels grubby and real. No animation, and nothing where the detective has magic powers.
cases.assessment: fields2 and anti largely retain MostWanted/Vengeance/TenDays; English fields2 adds SérieNoire darkcrime comedy. Strongest English control direct police realism remains hard to improve. No documentary exclusion invented.

cases.request: Something where halfway through you realise the person telling the story has been feeding you nonsense.
cases.assessment: Stockphrase RRF HeLovesMe #1 explicitly unreliable narrator and perspective reveal is stronger direct fit than generic reality puzzles. Ludo #2 merely nonlinear interconnected anthology remains weak. Lexical75 retains wrong-sense WordsOnBathroomWalls #1; nativephrase fields2 Game/Murk/AmericanSportsStory require specific narrator proof, not mere surprises.

cases.request: Give me car chases, but make it more getaway driver than superheroes destroying a city.
cases.assessment: Fields2 Refuge/HitRun/Ranam explicitly getaway drivers, but prior corrected chase-central BabyDriver is a stronger conjunction anchor. Lexical75 stockphrase DriveHard/Motorway/BabyDriver directly supported. Larger/full retention alone does not select quality.

cases.request: Brain’s fried. Something warm and funny, but not painfully cheesy.
cases.assessment: Fields2 cap64 HereWeGo/MooneBoy/FeverPitch all directly warm/comic. Lexical75 stockphrase same titles reordered. Anti holiday-heavy alternatives carry subjective cheesy uncertainty; no hard family/children ban.
